name.zh: 第一位天才，隐德来希，赞达尔

zh.name: 第一位天才，隐德来希，赞达尔
zh.desc: 以吕枯耳戈斯之名静观千百万次轮回的神礼观众，承载天才俱乐部#1赞达尔•壹•桑原的意志。以最初的「天才」权柄，执掌超越神话的伟力，试将漫长的实验导向「毁灭」的宿命。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成少量量子属性伤害。
使指定敌方单体目标获得<u>【潜能实现】</u>效果并立即行动。

240440102.name: 潜能实现
240440102.desc: 造成伤害提高，回合开始时回复生命值。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方目标造成少量量子属性伤害，将目标行动提前并解除其控制状态。同时对其施加<u>【二律背反】</u>效果。

240440101.name: 二律背反
240440101.desc: 终结技被激活，施放终结技时损失生命值，该伤害优先消耗护盾且不致命。在效果持续期间未施放终结技则在效果解除时将能量还原。

skill_list.skill_desc: 连续对我方随机单体目标造成少量量子属性伤害。
切换为【论证形态】。
对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成少量量子属性伤害。
使除自身外的敌方全体目标在自身处于【论证形态】时，永久获得<u>【风行】</u>和<u>【「律法」的惩戒】</u>效果。

240220101.name: 风行
240220101.desc: 处于【风行】效果的目标在回合结束时会立即行动，因【风行】效果触发的回合无法再次触发此效果，陷入弱点击破状态后解除。

240440103.name: 「律法」的惩戒
240440103.desc: 每次行动后损失生命值。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方2个目标造成少量量子属性伤害，将目标行动提前并解除其控制状态。同时对目标施加<u>【二律背反】</u>效果。

240440101.name: 二律背反
240440101.desc: 终结技被激活，施放终结技时损失生命值，该伤害优先消耗护盾且不致命。在效果持续期间未施放终结技则在效果解除时将能量还原。

skill_list.skill_desc: 连续对我方随机单体目标造成少量量子属性伤害。
对我方全体造成大量量子属性伤害，伤害由目标<u>平均分摊</u>，且伤害会根据强化的次数提升，并使等同于强化次数数量的我方目标大概率陷入纠缠状态。同时切换为【演化形态】。

401301001.name: 平均分摊
401301001.desc: 本次攻击结算前的伤害和负面效果由所有受击目标平均承受。

skill_list.skill_desc: 当前处于【演化形态】。在行动序列上生成【神话生命演化系统】，每次【神话生命演化系统】行动时在场上生成【泰坦眷属】。敌方目标从场上生成或我方忆灵被召唤累计达到一定数量后，赞达尔将施放【SET 论证方法=黑潮】。
当前处于【论证形态】，场上会不断生成【黑潮造物】。同时在行动序列上生成【CALL _毁灭论证法】，每次【CALL _毁灭论证法】行动时，使下次赞达尔施放的【求解：第一因之果】获得强化。敌方目标被消灭、我方角色陷入无法战斗状态或忆灵消失累计达到一定数量后，赞达尔施放【求解：第一因之果】。
每次切换形态时使自身受到的伤害提高。

en.name: First Genius, Entelechy, Zandar
en.desc: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member #1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.
Grants <u>"Potential Realization"</u> effect to one designated enemy unit and causes them to immediately take action.

240440102.name: Potential Realization
240440102.desc: DMG dealt increases, and HP is restored at the start of turn.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target, advances their action and dispels control states on them. Additionally, applies the "<u>Antinomy</u>" effect on them.

240440101.name: Antinomy
240440101.desc: Unit's Ultimate is activated. Using the Ultimate prioritizes reducing Shield and causes Non-fatal HP loss. If the Ultimate is not used during the effect duration, the Energy will be restored when the effect ends.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals successive minor Quantum DMG to random single targets.
Switches to "Disputation Mode."
Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.
While this unit is in "Disputation Mode," permanently grants all friendly units (except this unit) the <u>"Stormride"</u> and <u>"Retribution of 'Law'"</u> effects.

240220101.name: Stormride
240220101.desc: Targets affected by "Stormride" will immediately take action after the turn ends. Turns triggered by "Stormride" cannot be triggered again. This effect is dispelled after being inflicted with Weakness Break.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to 2 targets, advances their actions, and dispels control states on them. Additionally, applies the <u>"Antinomy"</u> effect on them.

240440101.name: Antinomy
240440101.desc: Unit's Ultimate is activated. Using the Ultimate prioritizes reducing Shield and causes Non-fatal HP loss. If the Ultimate is not used during the effect duration, the Energy will be restored when the effect ends.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals successive minor Quantum DMG to random single targets.

Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets that is <u>distributed evenly</u>. DMG increases based on the number of enhancements, and has a high chance to inflict Entanglement on targets equal to the number of enhancements. Simultaneously, switches to "Evolution Mode."

401301001.name: Even Distribution
401301001.desc: The DMG and debuff before this attack's finalization is received evenly by all targets that are hit.

skill_list.skill_desc: Currently in "Evolution Mode." Generates "Mythical Life Evolution System" in the Action Order. Each time "Mythical Life Evolution System" takes action, generates "Titankin" on the field. After a certain number of friendly units have been generated on the field or target memosprites have been summoned, Zandar will use "SET Proof_Method=Black_Tide."

Currently in the "Disputation Mode." "Black Tide Creatures" will continuously appear on the field. "CALL _DESTRUCTION_THEOREM" will also be generated in the Action Order. Each time "CALL _DESTRUCTION_THEOREM" takes action, it enhances Zandar's next "Query: Prime Mover's Outcome." Zandar will use "Query: Prime Mover's Outcome" after a certain accumulation of friendly units being eliminated, target characters being knocked down, or memosprite disappearances is reached.
Each mode switch increases this unit's DMG received.
